TypeValue.Text:
Unlocks the Winter's Presence collection.
Purchased for 3  + 25,004  from the Charity Corps Seraph (Gift Wrapping) at The Crown Pavilion only available during Wintersday.
Hint: Created with snowflakes in the Mystic Forge.
Hint: Created with snowflakes in the Mystic Forge.
Hint: Created with snowflakes in the Mystic Forge.
Hint: Complete the Sounds of the Season achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)
Hint: Complete the Snowball Fight! achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)
Hint: Complete the Wintersday Gauntlet achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)
Hint: Complete the Toy Quality Control achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)
Hint: Complete the Frozen Claw achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)
Hint: Complete the Festive Imbiber achievement. (Only available during Wintersday)

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path northwest and jump down the buildings until you reach the platforms looking south back towards the first waypoint. Using Zephyr Skill 3 (Assisted Leap) jump the two platforms to the crystal.

Southeast of the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on a platform just above the shore. At the base of a rocky pillar to the northwest (where crystal 3 is), jump on the coracle for a boost, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to get up the pillar (obtain crystal 3 if you don't have it yet), and then Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross over to crystal 2.
Due east of the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on a rocky pillar above the shore. Jump on the coracle for a boost, and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to get up the pillar.
From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise down to the platform with the Springer Rental NPC. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the crystal due southwest of the platform edge.
On a bamboo platform just west of the Sky Docks Waypoint. Use the nearby Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap).

Northeast of the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on a platform above the water. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) from the wooden ledges to the west of the crystal to reach the first platform, then jump up to the second.
At the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump onto the top of the west end of the ship.
This crystal is on the roof above Drooburt's Ghost. Start at the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump up from the east side of the roof.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, follow the river northeast. Climb up the pole leading to the platform above the water. Use Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break) to pass through the waterfalls and stop on each platform before repositioning.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north, follow the path to the bridges crossing under the waterfalls, use Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break) to pass through them. At the top, continue east and cross the pool of water, but hug the left side. You should be able to see the crystal through a waterfall. Standing to the right of the waterfall, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to jump to the first platform and then cross the pole to the next platform.

Southeast of the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on top of the wooden poles emerging from a large net. Facing the wooden poles, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump onto either of the short poles, and then the same skill again whilst moving forwards to reach the crystal.

Northwest of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on a platform. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice to jump up the rock face north of the crystal, and then Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross to the south onto the platform with the crystal.
West and slightly north of the Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on the north side of a rocky outcrop, at very low level. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap).

On a pillar rising out of the sea, west of Sky Docks Waypoint. Jump down from the waypoint into the water below. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice to climb the rock ledges north of the pillar, and then Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross and climb up to the crystal (it looks too high but is just achievable).
Start at Sky Docks Waypoint. Head to the eastern edge, drop down onto the first platform, then the second platform, and finally down onto the wooden pole with the crystal.
From Bazaar Docks Waypoint head northeast into the water. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) straight up to the crystal on the wall.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north into the market. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to climb onto the awnings, walk up the slope, then use the skill again to reach the high beam with the crystal.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north and follow the path through the bridges using Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break). Enter into the cave and follow the path to the right, along the right wall. As you round the corner you will walk under two red cylindrical lanterns. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) at the foot of the rocks near those two red lanterns, and then again to leap up above the lanterns onto the wooden framework. Then, still facing west, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to jump to the roof of the shack with the crystal.

This crystal is on the roof of a hut halfway up a rock spire north of the eastern tip of the airship. Drop down into the water from Sky Docks Waypoint. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to gain some height on the grassy rockface. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to leap onto the wooden poles sticking out of the edge of the hut. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the roof and crystal.

Starting at Sky Docks Waypoint, find the Hot Air Balloon travel for Divinity's reach just west of the waypoint - there is a crystal on top of the adjacent house. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) on the rocks on the northern side, again to reach the hanging platform, and once more to reach the roof and crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, from the Morning NPC walk southwest under the beam up to the cliff edge. Looking down you can see two vertical poles with a horizontal pole between them. Jump down onto the left side of the horizontal pole. If you pan your camera you will now see the crystal just below you. Jump down to the cog on the left, then step forward to drop onto the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water and continue southeast. Keep going until you reach the long north-south island; the crystal is on a small vertical rock at the south end of it. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) on the rock formation twice to reach the crystal.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north and follow the path around the corner. Stop before reaching the bridges and waterfalls, and look back and point the camera up to see the crystal. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) on the sloped wooden roof behind the Ulster Weaponsmith NPC, and again to make your way west up the shack rooves, then walk down along the pole to the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest to the wooden balcony where the purple aspect skill crystal is (collect that whilst you're here). Bear in mind that your target Sky Crystal is immediately below the purple aspect crystal, amongst some wooden poles. Step off this platform onto the platform diagonally opposite to the northeast, and turn your camera back to the Sky Crystal. Choose one of: (a) Carefully use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to land on the pole to the left of the crystal, or (b) Carefully step off the edge and try and land on the poles. You will probably miss the landing a few times. When you land successfully, walk along the beam to collect the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice to climb the rock ledges north of the pillar, and then Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross and climb up to the rock pillar to the south (where crystal 14 was). There is another slightly taller pillar with a point at the top to the west; use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to it. Turn back north towards the cliff. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) on the grassy ledge to the right and below the Sky Crystal. Then use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump up to the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise down to the platform that appears on the map to be above the Raptor Rental NPC. This Sky Crystal is on top of a two storey red shack. Find the wind crystal at the northeast corner, then use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the roof. You won't be able to get close enough to stand directly on this crystal due to the low roof above, but by walking along the roof you can get close enough to interact with it.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path northwest to the wooden balcony. Drop down to the first balcony. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump on the crane - stand in the middle of the beam. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) on the lower-left roof (with respect to the roof with the Sky Crystal on it) - aim for the chimney. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the upper roof with the crystal.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north, follow the path to the bridges crossing under the waterfalls, use Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break) to pass through them. When you emerge into the cave, there is a wooden structure on the left with the crystal on it. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach it.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path northwest to the wooden balcony. Drop down to the first balcony. Climb the ramp to where the crane is. The crane's bucket is just over the edge of the platform with the crystal. Drop down onto it.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. There is a large pillar of rock with the Skimmer Slalom Time Trial on its northwest corner; head to the southwest instead. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to climb halfway up the rocky spire adjacent to the wind crystal and look toward it. Then instead of aiming for the sky crystal, aim for a shoulder of rock at the same level as the top of the spire you're currently on—you can land here. Finely, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) again to reach the crystal.
From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest. Pass between the Jackal Rental NPC and the rock pillar with the Griffon adventure on top of it. The crystal is just around the corner.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise and hop across the three suspended platforms. Stop at the platform which is above the Springer Rental NPC. The crystal is on the roof of a green shack. Aiming for the roof of that green shack, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) whilst standing on the railing. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) if you landed in the wrong spot. Walk over to the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest until you find Quintus Searclaw at the foot of the rock pillar with the griffon adventure on top. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to clamber up the sloped roof and wooden poles up to the Sky Crystal platform.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach the Springer Rental NPC platform. Continue southwest to the balcony. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross around the right-hand side of the cliff until you reach a wooden platform (this is where Sky Crystal 37 is). Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the rock spire to the south with Sky Crystal 34.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Head southwest, pass by the adventure and then head south past the beach tent and dancers until you reach the shacks stacked on a rock pillar. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) in the southwest corner on the grassy rock, and then again up onto the roof to get the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach Lumen, the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure NPC. Walk east from Lumen to the railing - you will see the crystal to the right of the rightmost water wheel. Jump onto the orange roof on the left. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to jump onto the wooden poles which extend from the leftmost water wheel. Jump along the poles then use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) again to reach the crystal, taking care not to clip the waterwheel (if you hit the water you will immediately fall).

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach the Springer Rental NPC platform. Continue southwest to the balcony. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross around the right-hand side of the cliff until you reach a wooden platform. Sky Crystal 37 is at the far corner of this platform.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Head southwest, pass by the adventure stop just after the beach tents and dancers. This rock pillar has the crystal on it. Approaching from the south, stand amongst the low lying tree and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice, then walk to the crystal.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, swim west under the stone arch above to the beach (beneath the Jackal Rental NPC above). Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) on the low lying rocks, then twice again to reach the crystal on the wall.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Swim due south to the first rocky gray island due south of the airship. Approach from the west and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the crystal.
From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Swim southeast to the grassy spire just south of the eastern end of the airship. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice to reach the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Swim southeast to the next rocky pillar, further east than Sky Crystal 41. Ignore the purple crystal. Approach from the north and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) once to stand on the hidden ledge in the bush, and then again to reach the green ledge above, and then finally a third time to reach the crystal.
From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Swim southwest to the far end of the long island. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to jump onto the roof with the crystal.

This crystal is pretty much above Ulster the Weaponsmith NPC. From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north, follow the path to the bridges crossing under the waterfalls, use Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break) to pass through the first two waterfalls only. Facing west, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the crystal in front of you.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest and keep heading northwest until you reach the railing. There is a rock with a glowing purple circle on the other side of the railing, hop onto it. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the middle platform. Targeting the orange roof with the crystal, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) once more to reach the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest, and then jump down northeast to the first and second wooden platform with ramps around a wooden shack. At the second platform, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the roof of the wooden house, and then again onto the easternmost vertical wooden pole. Face southeast. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the horizontal wooden pole just below the crystal visible in the distance. Then use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap).

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise down to the platform just above the Springer Rental NPC. Facing northeast towards the three waterwheels, you should be able to see the crystal beneath the rightmost waterwheel. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to hop onto the wooden roof to the left of Parker Cole. Follow the roof around the corner to get to the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, walk south up the gangplank to the airship. Jump off the ship when you reach the top and continue to swim to the farthest rocky island due south of the waypoint. Approach the island from the west. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the crystal at the top.

From Bazaar Docks Waypoint, head north, follow the path to the bridges crossing under the waterfalls, use Zephyr Skill 2 (Light Dash) and its flip skill (Sun Break) to pass through them. At the top, continue southeast into the cave and hug the right wall. When you see a Lionguard, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap)  to clamber up the angled rock shelf behind it. Follow the rock shelf around the corner and drop onto the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop into the water. Swim to the rock pillar in the farthest southeast corner of the map. Approaching from the northeast side, use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice to reach the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest until you reach the Water Balloons and the NPC Juno. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the roof on the right. Walk to the back of the roof and drop down onto the crystal.
From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northeast and drop off the cliff to the right of the Griffon Rental NPC, straight onto the crystal.

Compared to any of the crystals gathered under the Aspect Gatherer achievement, this is quite difficult to reach. Much the easiest way to reach this one is to rent a Griffon from the NPC at Sky Docks Waypoint, and fly east straight to the Master Crystal.

Alternatively, from Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach the Springer Rental NPC platform. Continue southwest to the balcony. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) and Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to cross around the right-hand side of the cliff until you reach a wooden platform with a wind crystal in the corner to recharge Skill 1 (you will need 8 charges). Climb up on the small rocky step next to the wind crystal, and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the suspended platform. Use the same skill to traverse up the: (1) wooden platform halfway up the scaffold, (2) the next suspended platform (very tricky, you need to be right on the edge of the platform), (3) the step on the scaffold, then walk to the northeast, (4) to the top of the scaffold, (5) continue to the purple crystal, (6) keep going up. Once at the top use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) in the indicated area to jump to the Master Crystal.

On the western windmill pillar (near the jackal rental), about half-way up the east side, near the top of the windmill.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest until you find Quintus Searclaw at the foot of the rock pillar with the griffon adventure on top. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) repeatedly to clamber up the sloped roof, wooden scaffold poles and wooden platforms. Where possible, try to jump from the hexagonal platforms as this reduces your chances of bumping into scaffolding above.

On the eastern pillar with the windmill (across the road from the jackal rental), on the roof of the highest house.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, head northwest and stand beside Quintus Searclaw. Look northeast facing up to where the Master Crystal is just out of sight. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to climb onto the top of the shortest windmill. Then use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) onto the crane on top of the second windmill. Finally use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the roof with the Master Sky Crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach Lumen, the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure NPC. Walk east from Lumen to the railing - you will see the crystal to the right of the rightmost water wheel. Jump onto the orange roof on the left. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to jump onto the wooden poles leading to the water wheels. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to gain some height onto the vertical poles halfway along. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to jump onto the jutting out roof above the leftmost water wheel. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to climb onto the roof in front of you, and then Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to reach the grass ledge on the left, and then again to reach the red roof of the waterwheel building.

Alternately, and much easier if you have sustained gliding, you can quite easily jump off the upper island (where the Sky Docks portal is), and glide into the updraft there, thence to the green patch shown in the last part of the effort. It would help to have either a springer or a couple leap/lightning pull skills to get to the final step.

When you're at the top, continue east and use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) to reach the Master Sky Crystal. (Note that once you're done, you can choose to reach Master Sky Crystal 9 from here too with Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) from the waterwheel building red roof).

On the cliff directly below Lumen and Proxima Gravegutte (on the small red house beside the green houses).

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach Lumen, the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure NPC. Walk east from Lumen to the railing, jump onto the red roof on the left and turn west towards the crystal. Walk carefully forwards, fall off the edge of the first roof and continue along until beneath the crystal. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to hop upto the Master Sky Crystal.

On the large island southwest of the airship, at the top of the rock with the stack of four houses.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, drop down into the water below. Swim and continue due southwest past the beach tent and dancers. Climb the grassy mound on the southwest side of the stack of houses, using Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) twice halfway up to return to the grassy slope. Stick to the right side of the slope at the very top (only the left slide is slippery) and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) agaim to reach the crystal.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise down to the platform just above the Springer Rental NPC. Facing northeast towards the three waterwheels, you should be able to see the crystal beneath the rightmost waterwheel. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) to hop onto the wooden roof to the left of Parker Cole. Follow the roof around the corner and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) again to reach the Master Sky Crystal.

Across the three jumping platforms next to the Wind Guide, above the red houses, at the very top of the scaffolding.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach Lumen, the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure NPC. Head south to the balcony and find the NPC Sunflower. Facing east and looking up, use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) onto the roof. Hop up onto the gray beam and use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) onto the next brown roof, and then the same skill again onto the red roof. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) back onto the scaffolding and finally Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) up to the Master Sky Crystal, taking care not to knock your character on the beam above.

From Sky Docks Waypoint, follow the path clockwise until you reach Lumen, the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure NPC. Head southeast and find Lionguard Jess. Use Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) onto the red roof on her left. Use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull) onto the gray beam, and then Zephyr Skill 1 (Assisted Leap) up to the Master Sky Crystal.

Alternatively, follow the route above for Master Sky Crystal 4 and turn west at the end and use Zephyr Skill 3 (Lightning Pull).

On the cliff high above the springer rental, in a small niche. It does not appear to be possible to reach this Master Aspect Crystal without use of either a glider or a mount.
Glider method

From Sky Docks Waypoint, walk to the cliff edge between the building and Master of Wind. Jump and glide southeast, towards the updraft.

At the top of the updraft, turn left, aiming for the ledge along the cliff, above and left from the wooden platforms. Walk along this ledge, past the bamboo, until you are in a shrub. Ahead of you is a rounded slope with more shrubs. Aim Lightning Pull at the cliff wall above the shrub on this next hill. You'll bounce down into a small dent between two shrubs.

Walk through the next shrub, hopping up the trunk a bit for visibility. The next ledge is bordered by a wall made of triangular edges. Use Assisted Leap and activate your glider at the top. Glide towards the wall, pressing forward to hug up against the wall. Carefully walk along this wall, staying as close as you're able, until you reach the next-to-last triangle sticking out. Use Assisted Leap again, and glide around the corner at the top of the leap. Deactivate your glider again very soon, when you are near the bamboo on the next ledge. (It's a very short glide.) The Master Crystal is in a depression on the left.

Griffon method (route shown on the map)

Alternatively, rent a Griffon from the NPC at Sky Docks Waypoint (or use your own). Walk up to the airship south of the waypoint, and fly northeast with the Griffon from the prow of the airship, aiming for the cliff edge above Master Sky Crystal 1. Head west along the green clifftop path and use the Griffon to get up the slope midway along. Master Sky Crystal 10 is in a furrow at the end of the path.

Name: The Rise and Fall of Kookoochoo

TypeValue.Text: This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan with a wispy, pathetic puff of smoke issuing from its mouth.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incombustible.”
Upper level. Speak to Folamh the bartender.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a forlorn quaggan sitting alone on a stage.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inconsequential.”
Upper level. Near a Water Balloons, on the first roof of the house next to Juno, cliff side.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan giving a half-hearted wink and nod to the viewer.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Insecure.”
Upper level. On wall of tall buildings next to lightning crystal and where a Charr Lionguard and a human Child are standing.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan clumsily firing arrows at a target with a bow.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inaccurate.”
Upper level. On the cliff hidden by leaves. Under the Water Balloons, sometimes there is a Quartz Crystal Formation nearby.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a sad quaggan with a bow in one hand and a white bandage around its arm.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Infirmed.”
On the cliff, at the west of the pillar of Labyrinthine Cliffs Griffon Master adventure, under a Sky Crystal.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan looking despondent as he hides under a stage.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Insubstantial.”
Under a tree, south of the pillar of Labyrinthine Cliffs Griffon Master adventure, almost at the height of the Upper Level (not at the water).
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan attempting to call attention to his injured arm to garner sympathy.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Invalid.”
West of Zephyrite Memorial and under the Hot Air Balloon.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan that’s puffed up and enraged upon a stage as fearful passersby look on.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Infuriated.”
West of Sky Docks Waypoint, under a lightning crystal.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan with a bottle in hand telling off color jokes and insulting audience members.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Indiscreet.”
Upper level. At the bottom of the tree, north of Zephyrite (Aspect Arena).
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan being beaten by angry pirates yet still bearing a strange grin.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incautious.”
On a grassy patch sticking out, halfway down the cliff beneath the motor holding the aircraft.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan engulfed in flames while an audience looks on and cheers.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Infernal.”
Ascending to upper level. On a ledge reachable via Lightning Pull.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan seemingly spewing vitriol to a shocked audience.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Invidious.”
Ascending to upper level. On a wall above a bench.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan whose actions are obscured by a large black box.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inappropriate.”
Next to Rollo, opposite the Karma Merchant on the same platform.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan that appears glass-eyed and confused while a bemused crowd looks on.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incoherent.”
West of Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure, at the end of a net under a lightning crystal.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a crazed quaggan rolling in a large pile of dead fish to the delight of a boisterous crowd.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inane.”
On a ledge just under the Lightning Guide.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan speaking intently on a soapbox adorned with politically-charged posters.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Iniquitous.”
Above the Lightning Guide, slightly to the east on top of a flat roof
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan speaking to a noticeably confused group of bystanders.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inexplicable.”
Southwest of the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure, there is a wind crystal, the torn flier is on the opposite wall of the house.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan proselytizing while two groups in his congregation bicker.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incongruous.”
South of the Labyrinthine Cliffs Crystal Collection adventure, under an overhang behind a bench.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan amid slogans that border on the ludicrous as confused citizens look on.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incomprehensible.”
On the top of the northern sluice gate (water source), above the lowest waterwheel.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan on stage with a close-knit group of followers hanging on his every word.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Infallible.”
Just above a small roof, on the cliff south of and beneath the highest waterwheel.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan looking on as a group of followers intimidate a vocal critic of his.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Indisputable.”
On a roof at the east of Hylek Stranger and above Misty.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan torn between the attentions of two distinct groups, each carrying signs.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incontrovertible.”
On a wooden platform hooked on the cliff; from the merchant Andile look out to the stone tower straight ahead, the flier platform is on your left.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan that’s speaking to an audience where most of them have turned away.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Inscrutable.”
In the cavern on a wall to the right of merchant Lonan, between him and the waterfall, near the candles.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan surrounded by two groups that are carrying signs supporting opposing ideas.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Indubitable.”
On a roof, directly above Weaponsmith Ulster. Also directly next to a Sky Crystal.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan beset upon by belligerent supporters and angrily biting an asura’s fingers.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Intemperate.”
Ground level. Northeast of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, on a post behind the side of some merchant displays
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan and his followers persecuting those defending an asura with bandaged fingers.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Intolerant.”
Ground level. East of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, under a basket.
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan foaming at the mouth and attacking his one-time followers.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Insane.”
Ground level. Northwest of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, behind some crates
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan with iron chains about his wrists and ankles being escorted away by Lionguard.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incriminated.”
Ground level. East of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, between two baskets on the end of a dock
This flier is torn and weathered, featuring a drawing of a quaggan before a robed magistrate as three of his former followers testify.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Indicted.”
West of Bazaar Docks Waypoint, inside the ground floor of the boat cabin.
This flier is torn and waterlogged, featuring a drawing of a forlorn quaggan sitting behind bars in some unnamed prison.  Below are the words “Kookoochoo the Incarcerated.”
Underwater. Under Bazaar Docks Waypoint, under a plant below the boat.
Not much good for storing things anymore.
This probably had a really amazing treasure map inside it before it broke.
Another fisherman's poor luck is also your poor luck.
Still works if you don't mind splinters.
A rod that can't bend will break. There's probably some wisdom in there, or at least physics.
Imagine a world where your equipment wears out and has to be replaced. The ancients must have had a hard time of it.
Sometimes the cage gets something stronger that it's meant for and they break out. Other times something bigger is hungry and breaks in.
An unrecognizable figure. If this had been made of jade, it would still be in good shape.
This wood is very wet. One could even say waterlogged.
Some kind of rare and unusual breed... No, it's just a stone that looks like a fish.
Looks like someone managed to lose the same leg twice.
Nothing breaks machinery like water. A good explosion or a hammer can certainly do it, but not the way water does.
Some people quit fishing because their net income isn't high enough.
This statuette has the head of a horned lion and tail of a fish. It's like nothing you've ever seen in Tyria.
Some rich navigator must have lost this overboard.

In the Imperator's Core instance for the New Friends, New Enemies episode, on the desk in at the center of The War Council in front of Claw of the Khan-Ur.
In the Imperator's Core instance for the New Friends, New Enemies episode, on the desk at the center of The War Council next to some scrolls.
Found on the ground after defeating Caros Burntgrip during the last instance of The Battle for Cragstead. The Letter will appear in front of the portal.
On a workbench just before entering the Steam Pipes Room in the booby-trapped hallway after rescuing all the prisoners (found after all the other books in the instance).
Behind a pipe in the southeast corner of the last Coolant Box room (found after the Torn Page from Kostya's Lab Journal).
Torn Page from Kostya's Lab Journal (Molten Furnace)
Torn Page from Kostya's Lab Journal
On a table north of the Pile of Scraps in the room after the Thermal Core encounter (found before Rodion's Blood Transfusion Results).
Next to the scrap metal tower/hut encountered after backtracking from freeing the very first prisoner. This is behind a gate that will not be open before the first prisoner is freed.
Found in the Molten Furnace instance, on the body of a charr in a hanging cage next to the area containing the first prisoner. Jump from the small platform to the cage.
Take Crumpled Pages to Sten Veilshredder in the Ruins of Rin,  Ruins of Rin Waypoint — .

Found in the Molten Furnace instance, on the body of a norn near the end of the prisoner section, on the west side of the exit ramp from the large room with the rock crushers. Walk up the ramp, and just before the first fence, turn right and go down the short ledge to reach the body.
Take Torn Letter to Yngvald in the Wolf Lodge at Hoelbrak,  Wolf Waypoint — .
Found in the Molten Furnace instance, on a body that can be found underneath a grated walkway, at the end of the bridge leading to the room with the rock crushers.
Take Crude Drawing to Innkeeper Aela at the Eastern Ward Waypoint in Lion's Arch,  Eastern Ward Waypoint — .
At the start of the instance, behind the first enemy portal.
In the first side pocket as the drill moves through the tunnel.
In the second side pocket as the drill moves through the tunnel.
In the third side pocket as the drill moves through the tunnel.
In the fourth side pocket as the drill moves through the tunnel.
In the fifth side pocket as the drill moves through the tunnel.

In the fifth side pocket up on the ledge. Follow the drill into the next cavern, past the Embers on the right, then instead of proceeding left toward the first steam geyser wall, turn right and jump up the rocks to a spider tunnel leading back to the pocket.
From Ore Node 7, jump along the raised ledges. This node is hidden behind more spiderwebs.
After Ore Node 15, after the last set of prisoners. The node is inside the caged-off area with active rock crushers. Stay as close to the wall as possible to avoid being crushed.
After the last steam geyser wall, jump up on the mushrooms and rocks to your left and go back. Jump through the geyser wall to get to the node.

In the northwestern end of the large lava cavern after the steam geyser walls, before proceeding to the fenced area with the Thermal Core. From the opening into the cavern, either drop down to the left first for Ore Node 12 then wrap back around through the lava, or hug the right wall of the pathway down, then jump down into the lava, across to the node on the other side. Continuously jumping while in the lava reduces the damage taken. From here you will not be able to jump back up. Make your way, as much as possible out of the lava, under the rock bridge and to the stepped stones under the grated platform, where you will be able to climb back up.

At the entrance to the large lava cavern after the steam geyser walls, hug the wall to the left. The ore is on a rectangular ledge that can be seen if the camera is rotated to look down. Get as close to the wall as you can and carefully step off the upper ledge, you should land next to the ore. Jump your way through the lava to reach the stepped stones under the grated platform, where you will be able to climb back up.
After destroying the Thermal Core, behind the giant sonar weapon being tested. Go up the ramp then over the control levers, down and around the destroyed sonar weapon.
Near the second set of prisoners, on the left. Jump up the boulder and the node is between the two sets of crystals on the top.
After the third set of prisoners. Once you reach the end of that ramp, turn right and walk under it to mine the ore. It is the ramp immediately before the waterfall of molten ore.

At the the very end of the instance, after the detonation, a 30 second timer starts in which you need to escape the facility. On your way out, after passing fire piping vents, jump left on a ledge and follow it to reach the last node.

From the waypoint, go north, north of the Mercenary Encampment PoI and east of the Iota Vault PoI. Find the prison, a fenced-in area with friendly (green) prisoners and a sniper tower in the middle. Directly southeast of the prison's eastern metal door is a metal plate that leads south to a scaffold with a lantern sticking up. Behind the lantern is a small ramp that descends far into the rock. The recording is at the very bottom in a corner.

Destroyers route
Vista route

Use the Thermal Tube north of the waypoint to get launched towards the Gate of Fire point of interest. From there, run northwest to get the Oakheart Essence past the Diving Goggles. From the Oakheart Essence, glide south west, looking for a lower platform filled with destroyers. Enter a small tunnel on this ledge and go to the very end of the tunnel, and use the Oakheart's Reach skill to get the recording which can be found on the ledge above.

An alternative way is to head towards the vista in Rata Arcanum by using the thermal tube north of the Heathen's Hold Waypoint. In the corner by the western bouncing mushroom below the vista is a hard to notice hole that drops down to the recording.

Roughly above the Sub Landing POI, head towards the vista in Rata Arcanum by using the thermal tube north of the Heathen's Hold Waypoint and heading northwest towards the Diving Goggles. From the vista, head west and glide down into a small hole for the recording.
Mercenary Encampment —

Take the metal ramps from the northeastern edge of Wurm's Furnace, first north, and then to the east. Go under the rock arch that is between the tent and a rock pillar, going straight until you hit a dark brown wall. Follow the wall to your right (southeast) until you fall into the small hole with the recording.
Mercenary Encampment —
Take the metal ramps from the northeastern edge of Wurm's Furnace, first north, and then to the east, to reach a tent located under three copper pipes. The recorder is behind that tent.
Eternal Pool —

From the Heathen's Hold waypoint, run southwest towards the edge of the cliff. Glide in this direction until you spot an area with wasps and fireflies. With Ley Line Gliding, you can make it to the ledge southwest of Zeta Vault. Run up the hill past the Oakheart's Essence and take both bouncing mushrooms. Run south southwest towards the path shown on your map. Follow the left wall to find a small cave up a few rocks, it will appear to have pale yellow webbing in it. Enter the cave to find the recording.

Head northeast from the waypoint, picking up the Oakheart's Essence. Continue northeast until you find yourself on a ledge in with what looks like two caves with blue plants growing from the ceiling. Glide towards them and aim Oakhearts reach up in the ceiling of the left cave to reach the area. If you miss, it's possible to hit with Oakheart's Reach from the ground. The recording is in the back of the cave.

Alternate route: Head northeast from the waypoint and use a skyscale mount to fly across to a cave above the mushroom soldiers with blue glow in it. The recording is just inside this small cave.
Nu II Vault —

Using the thermal tube north of the Heathen's Hold Waypoint, and then use the second thermal tube near there but start gliding when you are able to and head towards the Sandstone Archway point of interest. Pick up the Oakheart Essence on top of the arch and glide northwest. Use Oakheart's Reach to get into the cave full of grubs and bats past the earth elementals. Head west and deeper into the cave. Use Oakheart's Reach on the upper portion of the southwest wall to reach the ledge with the recorder.
Peace Grounds —

From the Heathen's Hold waypoint, run west to the edge, then jump off and turn around to glide toward the waypoint. Glide down slightly and northwest of the Peace Grounds point of interest toward a plateau that has wasps and an Oakheart's Essence. From the Oakheart Essence, follow the rock formation to the left. Look above you for a small crevice with blue hanging strands. Pull yourself into the crevice using no more than two charges of Oakheart's Reach. Once inside, use the last charge to pull yourself upward to the recorder. Alternatively, the jump can be made with a Springer (with high jump mastery) and a well timed launch from your mount (requires Bond of Faith Mastery).
Head northwest from the waypoint for a short distance until you find a small opening near the corner. Jump down into the hole to find the recording.
Viraddi's Salvation —

From Heathen's Hold waypoint, run south and glide down to the bristleback nest (east of and above Viraddi's Salvation). Pick up an Oakheart's Essence near the bristlebacks or smogscales in the area and head north around the rock on the map. The recorder is visible in a small cave at the north end of the area (visible when approaching from the south).
Iota Vault —

Enter the Iota Vault with an Oakheart Essence. Go into the cage to your right just as you enter, head to the back corner and grapple up to the ledge to find the recording.

Note: It is possible to enter the vault without activating the Entrance Terminal. Standing flush against the door and then triggering a reload of the map (by relogging or a temporary switch such as entering Heart of the Mists or Guild Hall then exiting) will load the player inside the vault. The door can be opened by the Exit Terminal inside to allow other players through.
Viraddi's Salvation —

From the Heathen's Hold waypoint, run southwest in the direction of the letter A in "Blistering Abyss" on the map. Jump off the edge and continue in this direction until you spot an area filled with wasps, you can either drop down to it or continue gliding if you are able, but start heading south east, looking for an Oakheart's Essence in front of a rockface with blue glowing plants. Pick up the Oakhearts Reach from the Essence, and  look south for a crevice with Cave Bats inside, and use Oakheart's Reach to enter it, then make a right when inside to find the recording. Alternatively, if you are on the layer below the waypoint, it is south of Viraddi' Salvation, so if you approach from the cave with Rolling Devils, look up for a ledge with blue fungus hanging below. The cave is above those fungus strands.
Nu II Vault —

With Ley Line Gliding:

Start at Ancient Hollow Waypoint, head to the southwestern edge and follow the ley-line up towards a cave filled with mushrooms. Take an Oakheart's Essence from the west end of the cave. At the westernmost edge of the cave, you should see an open area filled with updrafts and unbound magic. On your right is a ledge with another Oakheart's Essence and some earth elementals. Glide to it, using Oakheart's Reach to gain height mid-glide. Enter the cave on the ledge, and head to the northeast corner to find the recorder.

Without Ley Line Gliding: Start at the sandstone archway, then head west into the mushroom cave. From there, follow the same route as above.

From Heathen's Hold, drop down to the level with the Druid's Grotto, then go south past the bristlebacks. The cave has vampire beasts in it. We must use Oakheart essence to get into the north portion of the cave above the vampire beasts.
Savage Rise: At the source of the waterfall at Peace Grounds.

Savage Rise: Underneath an outcropping north of Scout's Clearing.
Savage Rise: At the entrance to a ramp that leads to Scout's Clearing.
Savage Rise: Near the base of a massive rocky pillar, southwest of the Peace Grounds.

Savage Rise: A Cave in the ceiling below Heathen's Hold waypoint.
Jump off from Heathen's Hold and circle back. Use Oakheart Essence on roof of cavern and glide to ledge.
Savage Rise: In a cranny within the bristleback's nest.

From Heathen's Hold Waypoint, head west across the northmost ridge of Titan's throat until you reach an Oakheart's essence. Jump off of Titan's Throat and glide down the hole below the cliff with the essence, facing the wall in the direction that the westernmost cliff of Titan's Throat is pointing. Once you glide below the wall and see blue plants, there is an updraft column that will carry you to a ledge leading into a small cave. The Firestone Shard is in the back of this small cave.
Wind Rider Ledge: Near the ceiling along the western wall.

Start from the Ancient Hollow Waypoint, grab an Oakheart Essence, and head southwest to the leyline. Pick the west-most leyline, glide up along the leyline into the mushroom cave, run straight through it and glide out the other side. Use Oakheart's Reach to get up to the ceiling where you can find another Oakheart Essence to the southwest. Glide around the corner to the left and keep heading south. This shard is suspended from a stalactite slightly to the southwest - land on the nearby ledge, run up the wall and glide back towards/beneath it to collect it.

(If you don't have the leyline mastery, you can also get here by using the thermal tubes west of the Heathen's Hold Waypoint, then jumping beneath Rata Arcanum, making use of updrafts below if you need to collect one of the low-lying Oakheart Essences).
Wind Rider Ledge: On the northern side, in a ceiling crevasse.

Start from the Ancient Hollow Waypoint, grab an Oakheart Essence, and head southwest to the leyline. Pick the west-most leyline, glide up along the leyline into the mushroom cave, run straight through it and glide out the other side. Use Oakheart's Reach to get up to the ceiling where you can find another Oakheart Essence to the southwest. Glide around the corner to the left, then reach up the ceiling and go a short distance east. This shard is on a ledge near the top of the ceiling.
Wind Rider Ledge: High along the wall, southwest of Seething Pillar.

Start from the Ancient Hollow Waypoint, grab an Oakheart Essence, and head southwest to the leyline. Pick the west-most leyline, glide up along the leyline into the mushroom cave - this time head west across the cave. Glide west and slightly northwest, making use of Oakheart's Reach if you're losing too much altitude. There will be a ledge with another Oakheart's Essence sitting on it. You want to land on the ledge directly below, populated with grubs and bats. There is a large dividing spur of rock on this shelf. To the right of this spur is a short slope; the shard is hidden in an alcove about halfway up if you hug the wall opposite the spur.

Alternatively, you can just head north from the updrafts beneath Rata Arcanum (useful if you're coming directly from shard #22 above), and glide down.
Wind Rider Ledge: Embedded high in a large palm tree.

Start from the Ancient Hollow Waypoint, grab an Oakheart Essence, and glide southwest and down to the Wind Rider Ledge. Use Oakheart's Reach to grapple up to a second Oakheart's Essence - the shard is half-way up the tree trunk of the tree beyond the second essence.
Wind Rider Ledge: In a cranny above the northern tip of the ledge.

Start from the Ancient Hollow Waypoint, optionally grab an Oakheart Essence, and head southwest to the leyline. Pick the west-most leyline, glide up along the leyline almost into the mushroom cave - then leave the leyline prior to the end (using it only to gain some height), and head west. Eventually you'll see a ledge below with a couple of Cave Bats on it and a Veteran Grub. The shard is at the back behind the Veteran Grub, on the left. (The Oakheart's Essence is purely to get out of the deadend after you've retrieved the shard.)

Page One: Caught within the Risen Lowlands.
Day 1: My comrades have been caging Risen that lurk on the beaches. They're trying to befriend them, but I don't agree with their methods.

West of Camp Reclamation is a sylvari food merchant. From the outside and to the west of her building, scramble up the rubble onto the platform with the arches to find the note in the middle of the floor.
Page Two: Studying the Orrian gorillas.
Day 2: I can no longer take part in capturing these creatures. I need to learn more about their natural state. I plan to go deeper into the island.
Southwest of the southeast shrine, the page can be found in a corner to the left of Botanist Willow.
Page Three: Atop an ancient citadel.
Day 3: Our Mother Tree strengthened sylvari willpower so we could refuse Mordremoth's corruption. I wonder, as I watch these wretched Risen, if they could get theirs back.
North of the Thoroughfare Ruins point of interest, on the second level of the building the Vista is on top of.
Day 4: I've stumbled across what appear to be their leaders. The winged ones have a strange effect on the rest. They make the others more...alert?
In the corner of a wide ledge west from southwest shrine.
Day 5: I've travaled farther inland. The architecture here is far more grandiose. It's truly a sight to behold. I'm amazed that the rise of Orr didn't completely reduce those monuments to rubble.
Located in Dwayna's Reliquary, on a wooden platform east and below the mastery point.
Page Six: Whispers from the wind.
Day 6: I barely made it out alive. I approached one of the winged Risen, hoping to speak to it, but the herd came charging at me. I fled as if my life depended on it. I messed everything up.
Northeast of Dwayna's Reliquary Vista, near Asuran storage triangle.
Page Seven: Statues of a fallen god.

Day 7: What a naive fool I've been. I'm walking in circles now. I find myself back at the spot where I spent the night. My wound is throbbing. I'll stay here one more night' to heal, then I'll try again.

After opening the second gate, you'll find a cart track inside the left-hand corner. Follow it up and around and the chest will be in front of you guarded by a Veteran enemy.

After Chest A, you can drop down to the right and follow the corridor to the north east. The chest is at the end.

Alternatively, after the first door, you can burn through an ice wall to the north east which leads into the same corridor.

After the first door, go north (past Bangar's route) and around to the left. Halfway along this back path, you can climb a ramp on your left. At the top cross the cart track bridge to the other side and follow around to the right. The chest is guarded by a Champion Stone Summit Crusher.
Take the back path as in Chest C, but continue along it to an ice wall. Burn through this, kill the Veteran Ice Troll, and go to the edge. The chest is now visible to your left.
You can just glide down southbound from the chest D point. After the big door, stick to the left wall and go down the ice ramp. Chest E is under the ramp.
Continue from chest E over the southern bridge (past the Champion Ice Beast) and the chest is found against the far wall.

At the middle bridge, take a right up the path to the northern bridge. On your right before that bridge is an ice wall. This pathway leads onto Almorra's ledge, and the chest is just prior to it on the left.
Go to the northern bridge and cross it. To the south west you should see a Veteran Icebrood Claymore on a circular platform. The chest is on the platform guarded by it.
This chest is underneath the second elevator (the one you use). Either pull the lever without standing on the elevator or glide down after you pull it (Prototype Position Rewinder also works).
After the elevator, follow the path to the first required ice wall. Instead, burn the ice wall to the north and defeat the Champion Ice Elemental. The chest is around the corner to your right.

At the second required ice wall after the elevator turn to your right. There is another ice wall on the right (easier to miss since it's on the inside of the corner). Through here is the chest, by the right hand wall.

When you get to the end of the path (before leaping down to face Almorra), do a 180 degree turn. As you double back, you will see the chest in an alcove on the left (hidden from view when heading to the end).

Dive directly downward from the location marked as Cave Entrance in the image to find the tunnel (underwater view). Consider trying for #39 next as you can continue on from here.

Note that there is also a cave in front of and on the sandbar where the token can be seen but not reached. The image shown is after having swam underwater. To get to the pool of water inside the cavern, dive in the shallow water to the east of the eastern most finger of the five southeast pointing finger-inlets of Burning Grotto. Not the wall of the pedestal itself but the lava rock circle around it. From the large, flat plateau north of the Pedestal of Flames and west of the Asura researchers, the entrance is between the first two stone spikes to its west (or counter clockwise if you're looking form the Pedestal of Flames). There's a narrow, but deep and twisting crevice with two short forks, one leads to the coin the other is a dead end.
Fractured Caldera: Along the riverbed of the magma outlet.

From the point of interest, go north into the volcano and towards the lava lake. At the lava lake, go south and follow the lava river through a cave – the token is on a ledge near the easternmost bend, close to the entrance.

Inside the jumping puzzle (note that #25, #29, and #31 are also inside the jumping puzzle but earlier, you might want to start with them), starting from the point just before the final long glide, after the fifth Refreshing Mist (which provides the buff Checkpoint 4), glide to the northeast onto the wall connecting Sopor Titanum with the west side of Fractured Caldera (see image). PLEASE NOTE: Going after this token will cancel your refreshing mist buff for the Skip up the Volcano jumping puzzle. It is recommended to complete the jumping puzzle first if you want the chest and achievement.

Caliph's Steps: On an upper tier of a large room to the northeast of the Sealed Entrance.
Sealed Entrance —

Requires   Lean Techniques for the forward speed. Starting the same way to #32, at the base of the slope leading up to  Caliph's Steps Vista — , there is a Mursaat Lore Tablet. To the right is the entrance to a grotto behind the rock shelves. This time glide forward to the rocks in purple light, then land below where two rock platforms meet over a gap that leads to the large room underneath. The token is on a high ledge at the back of this room.
  • It is important to maintain height in the next glide in order to land on the high ledge underneath. This can take several attempts, and there is no way to climb back up after falling to the floor. Skills like   Portal Entre /   Portal Exeunt,   Spectral Walk /   Spectral Recall,   Summon Flesh Wurm /   Necrotic Traversal,   Prepare Shadow Portal /   Shadow Portal, or using a Prototype Position Rewinder will help.
  • From the edge of the lower platform, jump forwards and glide through the gap, immediately turning to the right and holding forwards for the boost, all the way to the ledge, landing on the right side of it almost where it meets the wall.
  • You should be touching the ceiling as you glide in from the hole.
  • Try not to touch the right wall, as moving that far right will mean less height to make the ledge.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Vexa's Lab in Fireheart Rise. Enter and begin completing the mini-dungeon as normal, passing through the Vexa's Creations, Escher (take the portal directly ahead, then go up the right-side stairs to the next portal, then up the next set of stairs to the third portal to reach the exit), and Golem Assistant rooms. Immediately following the floating hexagon platforms with the golem assistants will be the Aetherblade cache guarded by three Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement. If you get in trouble, jump back down to the previous area. The Aetherblade will not chase if you run around the corner.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Tears of Itlaocol in Caledon Forest. Enter and complete the mini-dungeon as normal. While you'll likely need to clear the hylek on the outside to open the door, you can simply run past the Veteran hylek inside with Swiftness without fighting. Head towards the end and complete the puzzle. The Aetherblade cache will be further down the tunnel after the Grand Chest, guarded by three Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Sector Zuhl in Timberline Falls, just before the Only Zuhl jumping puzzle. Head to the Foundation 86 Waypoint and go inside the cave, staying on the right wall the whole time. You'll pass from dredge to bats and grubs, and then into a Murrellow area. Continue to hug the right wall and it will curve around to the left. Climb up the rocks. At the top of the cliff will be the cache and two Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement. You can use mounts to reach the cache.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Goemm's Lab in Metrica Province. Enter and complete the jumping puzzle as normal. Right before the boss will be the cache and two Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in the Hidden Garden in Mount Maelstrom. Complete one of the entrance events to gain access to Diedre's Steps. You do not need to complete the jumping puzzle. The cache can be found in the southeast corner of the area on the ground floor, guarded by three Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Fawcett's Bounty in Harathi Hinterlands. Enter and make your way through the jumping puzzle as normal, putting the boulders on the switches and always going left at intersections through the tunnels, until you reach the ship. Instead of doing the jumping puzzle to reach the ship, swim past it and go up the ramp to the exit. The cache is at the top of the ramp, just before the exit, guarded by two Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement.
It is possible to reach the ledge directly east of the Arca Waypoint by flying up high with a Skyscale or Springer and using Bond of Faith. You can tell the correct ledge by two pine trees growing on the cliff and a ghostly pirate in the entrance to the cave right where the cache is located.

This Aetherblade Cache can be found in Obsidian Sanctum in the Eternal Battlegrounds. Enter by going to the Eternal Battlegrounds and finding the Mystic Portal at a keep owned by your world. Complete the jumping puzzle as normal, use the Mystic Fountains as much as possible if you'd like to avoid enemies from other Worlds. The cache is located at the very end, one level down below the Enormous Mistwrought Chest (Obsidian Sanctum), guarded by three Aetherblades. Open the cache to get the achievement.

Big Tombstone at the cliffedge to the north.
The oozes are on the left of the hill just before the Queen Bee Dog. The farmer is on the grassy hill to the right upon entering the final area (after the fifth checkpoint).
The oozes are by the area below the third checkpoint before the improper water. The farmer is to the left just before the final checkpoint by a large tree.

The oozes are by the large tree hollow stump that slants down in the water before the Checkpoint #3. The ooze farmer is up above after Checkpoint #3. Players will need to jump over the decaying leaves and up heading towards the large hollow log near the hidden room with Moto's Breath.
The oozes are directly across from the checkpoint guarded by hillbillies/before the final waterfall. The farmer is by the final waypoint. Use the nearby Flower Launcher to reach him.

The Oozes are in a small alcove below checkpoint #9. After climbing the pagoda at checkpoint #8, and passing through the house filled with arrow traps and toads, you'll find the alcove with oozes immediately to your left. Once you've collected an ooze, head back to checkpoint #8 and jump back along the pillars until you reach the cloud path on your right. Follow this path all the way back up to the platform before/between the pillars after/and checkpoint #7. From there, jump down to the base of the first pillar and head on through the cloud section to the left. Right before the clouds turn into green landscape again, look to the right to find a small building where the farmer waits. As this distance is moderately long, it is suggested you purchase at least one health potion.

The Oozes are right next to a Portal before Checkpoint #4. As the ooze will be removed if the player enters a Portal, they will have to climb all the way up to the top. The ooze farmer is sitting on the cliff right next to the checkpoint.

World 1 Zone 1
(Sunny Glade)

Follow the Bee Dogs until you arrive on the hill at the exit of the maze. Inspect the wall at your left, you should see a red crystal. Hitting it will make several wooden platforms appear, follow them to access to the top of a wall. You should now see the glitch not far from you.

World 1 Zone 2
(Dark Woods)

At the end of the zone, before the last checkpoint, just after crossing the poison water with the shopkeeper and hidden furniture shop, use the two mushrooms along the tree that you would normally use to bypass the bottomless pit. Look directly to the right. You should see the red crystal switch near the wall. Follow the created path and jump against the green wall. You should see a portal. Take it, it will lead you to the glitch.

World 1 Zone 3
(Kingdom of Fungus)

Follow the path you would take normally to reach the Moto skill scroll, pass through the little cave guarded by a crocodile, jump to the top with bouncing mushrooms. Once you are at the top of the tree, look towards the left, there is a floating glitch.

You can either activate the wooden platforms by hitting the red crystal next to the tree trunk, or bypass them by shooting the glitch with your Slingshot.

World 2 Zone 1
(Rapids)

The switch is near the shop overlooking the logs river near the end of the level. Once passing the checkpoint before the river, head to the river and reach the geyser on the left side of the river, continue this way and climb, use jump flowers to reach the shop and then the switch. The switch will be towards the waterfall. Hit the switch using the slingshot or a bomb, then follow the path created by the switch.

World 2 Zone 2
(Pain Cliffs)

At the last checkpoint when following the hard path, just after the portal "maze", at the second floor (above the checkpoint) you will find the furniture shop as well as the switch. Drop down under the checkpoint on the plank and follow the spiral path.

World 2 Zone 3
(Storm Top)

After checkpoint #4, travel through all 3 portals and follow the pointing fingers up the mountain where you'll find 2 more portals. Take the hard path (unhappy arrow portal). Then proceed to checkpoint #9. After jumping along a path of clouds, you'll arrive to an area filled with spikes. Head right and you'll find a closed mouth gate. Play the gatekeeper lullaby (332331) to open the mouth, then enter the portal on the right to find the glitch. There are three switches for this glitch, activate them all to complete the puzzle. You'll need to use a bomb on the third switch.

Can be found in the first room behind a waterfall. To get there, run towards the green bauble in the pool of water on the cave floor. After falling into the pit, follow the cave and jump onto the bouncing mushroom at the end. Follow the path until you re-enter the main cavern, and turn left to see a green bauble on a scaffolding. From the bauble, jump directly into the waterfall into a secret cave where you will find the first chest.

After completing the cave with a crystal in the flowing water, turn back from the following checkpoint. A secret cave is located behind the large waterfall flowing into the void. The entrance is quite tall, and is located just left of the central white stream of the waterfall. Activating the checkpoint is highly advised, as a missed jump will result in death. Inside this cave is a short jumping puzzle with crystals, and the second chest at the end.

After climbing the broken bridges section, look left at the first set of wooden scaffolding wall. Jump from the floor into a gap in the wall. Dropping down to the dirt patch below, then climb the rock pillars under the waterfall. Collect the green bauble here and walk into the waterfall, into a secret cave. Jump up through the cave, dropping down after collecting the blue bauble at the top to a lower platform. Pass through the waterfall once more and jump to a small cave with a spider. Very precise platforming is necessary to cross the following large cavern and reach the third chest.
Buy from the traveling Potion Cart!
Sold by the potion seller merchant at the start of the zone for 500 Baubles.
Unlock a chest in a secret cave!

Use a key to unlock the chest behind the crumbling wall in the starting area found below the second campfire after the floating bridge. A key is available from the shop located after the optional underwater segment at the start of the level for 25 Baubles.
Defeat the oozes in a different secret cave!

Secret cave right after the third checkpoint. Instead of running across the long bridge with Monkeys on it, turn left beforehand, bomb the secret cave entrance and fight the wave of Oozes. A chest with the seed will appear afterwards.

Baubles 1 - 4 are in the first room you spawn in. Baubles #1 and #4 are both visible immediately. Bauble #1 can be reached by carefully jumping into the water while avoiding the hole near it that leads to the underwater section that leads to Bauble #4. Alternatively you can jump into the hole, follow the way through the underwater cave, gather Bauble #4 and jump down from the wooden beam to gather Bauble #1

Bauble #2 is easily reached by following the wooden bridge up the ledge and instead of jumping over the bridge towards Checkpoint Nr. 2 turning right and jumping down onto the ledge where it is located

Bauble #3 is the trickiest to get in the first room. From the starting point travel along the two wooden bridges towards Checkpoint Nr. 2. Turn right after the second, partially destroyed wooden bridge to jump along the ledges. The last jump is around a stone pillar onto the platform with Bauble #3

As mentioned earlier, Bauble #4 is immediately visible when entering World 3. Jump down into the water hole near Bauble #1 leading to the underwater cave and follow the obvious way to the jumping mushroom and continue upwards when out of the water. Once you enter the big first room again, run along the wooden beams to reach Bauble #4

Between Checkpoint Nr. 2 and Nr. 3 you will find Bauble #5 and #6. Bauble #5 is reached by following the intended way to Checkpoint Nr. 3, but instead of going over the long wooden beam to continue to the other side, you run down the short wooden beam and jump around to the ledge with Bauble #5. Once you have collected Bauble #5 you can run up the short wooden beam again and continue on with reaching Bauble #6 and getting to Checkpoint Nr. 3

As mentioned already Bauble #6 is very easy to get and out in the open. Before grabbing it make sure to kill the 3 Monkey enemies to avoid getting thrown down the cliff. Continue up the hill to Checkpoint Nr. 3

In the next room you will find Bauble #7 and #8. Both are visible when you enter the room, although less obvious. From Checkpoint Nr. 3 continue running the intended way over the first wooden bridge, up the hill and over the second wooden bridge. It is recommended that you gather Bauble #8 before Bauble #7, this way you avoid unnecessary backtracking. Once you run over the second wooden bridge continue left and prepare to jump down. Jump along the pillars like shown in the screenshot towards Bauble #7. Shoot the monkeys with your Slingshot to avoid getting thrown off into the water.

As mentioned, Bauble #8 should be collected before getting Bauble #7. Once you've crossed the second wooden bridge after Checkpoint Nr. 3, instead of continuing left towards Bauble #7, you run right and jump around the ledges and pillars towards Bauble #8. After collecting it you simply jump down to the platform where you can continue jumping down for Bauble #7
The mountain has a back door.
Drop down from the final checkpoint without touching the flowers.
After checkpoint 1, hop along the trees and drop down from the ledge with two monkeys.
From cloud save 2, cross the pond using the lilypads and head straight to the wall. There are traps on the right side of the tree.
Either drop down from checkpoint 3, or head right before the big hollow tree, evade the jumping rock, keep going right and pass the log with a monkey standing on top.

From cloud save 4:
  1. Drop off to the left onto the platform below. Use bombs on the crocodile blocking the semi-secret passage (you can do this from ground-level) and then use it as a platform.
  2. Hop over the plants until you reach a wooden root. Climb up the root and aim your jump towards the right edge of the opposite root. From that root, do a long jump to get over to the next root, and then hop on the slanted root above it. This will take you to a series of bouncy mushrooms.
  3. Take the bouncy mushrooms up; while there are no traps on the way up, the direct path at the top will be blocked by a No Cloud. You can either move fast over to the other side before the No Cloud performs its knockback, or, you can use the bouncy mushroom on the opposite side to avoid the No Cloud.
  4. Once you are past the cloud, jump down to the store, which is where you can get Moto's Breath elite skill as well.
Right after checkpoint 2, jump to the lilypad before the acid waterfall. You will then need to jump straight through the waterfall. Don't exit the shop if you need shop 11!
From cloud save 3, go up and make a jump to reach the shop. The shop entrance is right by the green bauble.
From cloud save 4, go back to the big vertical trunk and drop off the side of the vertical stump to a corner where you will find the shop.

The shop is to the right of the final checkpoint but you can't get to it by hopping over the crocodile as his entire body is trapped. Instead you have to backtrack a little and jump on the mushrooms nearby so you can jump down to the shop.
Follow the steps for shop 7. Use a torch/candle to burn the carpet and throw a bomb at the uncovered ground. Jump down to reach the shop.

Before the final checkpoint, hop on the first falling logs, twist your camera to the wall and watch it closely for any wall sections that are different. If you notice a wall appears different, turn your camera towards the wall and start bombing it. When you hear the ding sound, you can jump in.

After the raft ride, get on the other side by throwing a bomb on the alligator and using the flower launcher. Don't take the direct path to the flower launcher because of traps. The shop is to the left.
The shop is located right before checkpoint 8, which is the checkpoint after you have emerged from the hillbilly cave.

This shop is all the way on the other side of the river with the floating logs, before checkpoint 8. But you can backtrack by taking the flower launchers right on top of the final checkpoint. You will need to then head to the other side of the river and look for a water spout near the very edge. From there, follow the ledge all the way down and climb up the back wall. You will then see a bouncy mushroom which will take you up to the two flower launchers that will lead you to the shop.
In the middle of the trees.

This shop is next to the shortcut eagle. You need the Glove of Wisdom to push the block below the shortcut eagle. Climb up the tree to the shortcut eagle and immediately jump to the hill nearby so you don't get transported away. Get to the top of the hill and then bomb the grassy area to reveal the entrance.

Bomb the grassy area on the next hill after you have reached checkpoint 7, which is the checkpoint after the piranha temple where you need to collect piranhas from the bottom pools and feed them to the octopus scale on the upper levels.
After checkpoint 9 (the checkpoint before the gong run), take the left path outside of the pagoda. Drop down at the end, instead of following the path right, and bomb the wall of the dead end.
After you hit the checkpoint right before the miniboss with the Glove of Wisdom, backtrack a bit to the two flower launchers and use them to get to the shop.
Right after passing checkpoint 2, drop down and keep going left. You will find a corner where you will need to throw a bomb on the wall to get in.

Make sure you have acquired the wooden whistle and learned, in-game, the song Gatekeeper Lullaby (332331).
  1. After reaching checkpoint 7, which is the checkpoint right behind the frozen waterfall, backtrack to the platform with the frozen waterfall.
  2. Jump through the clouds to your right. At the first split between the clouds, take the right path. At the second split, take the left path.
  3. When you get to the final trio of clouds:
    1. Play the note 3 while jumping to the first cloud of the trio and let it finish channel.
    2. After it has channeled, play 3 again quickly before jumping to the second cloud and play notes 23.
    3. Jump to the third cloud and play notes 31. If done correctly, the gate should open.
  4. There is also a No Cloud blocking your way just behind the second cloud, so you will need to keep some distance to avoid the knockback and then jump past it once the gate has opened.
  5. Bomb the left wall of the room to enter the shop. If you still need shop 12, leave this shop and bomb the wall to your left.

This shop is right before checkpoint 2 but you will want to save yourself at the checkpoint first before running to it or you may experience a long run back if you do happen to die on the way. There aren't any traps in front of the shop but there is a trap right under the ledge to the shop.
Follow the steps for shop 10 up until the wall bombing part. Bomb the middle wall of the room to enter the shop.
The shop indicated is hidden room #4 (just before the 3rd checkpoint) next to a long fallen log and large rock. Throw a bomb at the wall to the left of the rock.
Throw a bomb to the left of the waterfall before the 1st checkpoint.

There's a hole just before the ground gives way entirely between the 3rd and 4th checkpoints.
  1. Walk off the edge of the hole onto the root.
  2. Jump onto a second root on the right and again onto the next root slightly to the left.
  3. Jump around the vertical section to the other side of the root.
  4. From there, jump onto the root next to the ledge with the shop. Hop onto the ledge and enter the shop.
The shop visible to the left just before the 2nd checkpoint.
The shop on the ground below looking back from the 3rd checkpoint.
The shop at ground level after the 3rd checkpoint.

After Checkpoint 3, in the maze that leads to the Queen Bee Dog, take the first left after picking up the green bauble and bomb the floor when you reach a dead-end. Drop down to a darkened section (a Candle or Torch is recommended here), and jump over the spike traps to reach the shop. See image (1) below for a map.

Can only be reached in Tribulation Mode, located underneath one of the false floors in the final area with the Cage, in the far corner near where the Moon power-up barrel can be found. Climb around the back of the mountain (2a) and drop down carefully onto a ledge underneath the floor (2b). Then jump across to the stones lining the far wall and make your way to the large hole in the lava. Drop down into the hole for the shop.

When you first encounter poisonous water (referred to by the shopkeeper as "Improper Water"), jump across the lily pads and then throw a bomb at the notch in the wall to your right. The poisonous water will drain, revealing a hole you can enter, so jump down into it for the shop.
Just when you thought it was over!
In the final area, bomb the bottom of the tree stump where the Cage is located from the far end of the hollow log to reveal the shop.

Burn the carpet and bomb the center of Hidden Room 4 (a door hidden by the back roots of the large tree stump after the 3rd checkpoint and two alligators) and drop down to the area below. Jump into the mouth of the large alligator to reach the shop.

From Hidden Room 1 (the shop behind the waterfall below the 2nd checkpoint), burn the carpet and bomb the floor to reach Hidden Room 2, and from there bomb the waterfall on the left side, behind the Shopkeeper and carefully jump into it for the furniture shop.
