Make sure you have acquired the previous collection item - the Secret Key - before attempting this as the chest cannot be opened without it.

It is recommended to purchase some Health Potions from the first vendor before embarking, as you will be forced to spend some time in toxic water.

  1. Head towards Digging Spots #2 and #3
    1. Make your way towards Digging Spot #1 above the starting area, but stop on the second platform before jumping over to the final platform.
    2. Bomb the wall facing the final platform to open the path to the secret cannon. Jump into the barrel of the cannon to get shot to a nearby tree branch. Run to the top of the branch and jump down into the toxic water-filled area to the right.
    3. Follow the path of toxic water until you reach a dead end. Jump up onto the waterfall to your left and run back along it until you see a narrow ledge to your left (about halfway back the waterfall). Jump to it and climb up to the top.[1]
      • Tip: jumping constantly can help to minimize damage.
    4. Return to the back wall of the dead end and climb onto the ledge, then head left and drop down onto the next row of rocks. Make your way to the opposite end until you reach another waterfall and a swarm of snakes.
    5. Climb up onto the platform with a 1-Up (there are also two 50-bauble dig spots here).
  2. Run across the top of the wall until you reach the end of the maze. Drop down to find the chest.

Located after the first checkpoint, cross the river and then make a left before the bridge, and jump over the smaller river nearby. Looking up you'll see a tree above you. Jump back across the small river to the open section, climb up the wall on the left and, heading left again, jump from the ledge towards the tree seen earlier. Climb up left of the water and go along the lower set of ledges until you reach what appears to be the end of the ledge. Bomb the wall to reveal the shop, jump down to ledge right in front of it to enter.
Use the path mentioned at the start of Checkpoint 7 to Checkpoint 8 to get to the area with the green bauble. Bomb the wall by the two ferns to find the shop.
Use the cloud shortcut just after the fifth checkpoint, and shortly after reaching the clouds, stand on the small patch of crumbling clouds to find the shop.

Hint: New beginnings, the convoy enters a new world blindly. Tread the first path walked and one may find some clues.
Hint: Intellect, willpower, and fortitude are the hallmarks of the Forager; and if one needs to broaden their intellect, one must go to where it is stored.
Hint: To learn the answers of the obscure, one must ask a thousand questions. Search the halls of a place where you may seek those answers. Or, perhaps, even more questions.
Hint: Empathy, compassion, and nurturing nature; one must know sorrow to heal sorrow. One can almost picture an entire sea of lamentation out there... Somewhere.
Hint: The mirror looks at himself and sees benevolence, but under that veil is something more modest. Insecure. The world around him swirls awake, but his has remained stagnant.
Hint: The rock we all stand on, this unshakable driving force... It will take a special kind of soul to guide us forward. A warden, protecting his flock.
Hint: Banished from their world and cast adrift, his loving soul and webbed hands turned to nurture his new allies.
Hint: Cause and effect, self-control and tolerance. Seek out a place where the veil runs thin and concentrate on the voices in your head.
Hint: The stag has fought long, lost much, and worked her craft where the ghost of their mentor dwelt.
Hint: Questions and answers, the everlasting cycle. If only one could forge a key to all the answers...
Hint: Magic can be used to heal, transmute, and inspire, but for this bastion, they focus on battle. Learn the poses and complete the spell.
Hint: Trapped within a certain framework, the mind never slumbers. Help yourself by helping the one who cannot die.
Hint: The templar has lived century by century; she knows death and has dealt death. Reach for divinity and the secrets it holds.
Hint: Patience and moderation share a tune with the natural rhythm of the world. This card can be found where those who study nature reside.
Hint: Addiction, loss, determination... The one lost to the abyss; her father mourns. Perhaps a clue can be found at the scene of the tragedy.
Hint: Chaos and destruction, the last bastion against the void. Every door holds more questions. Reach the top of the tower and unravel them yourself.
Hint: Hope for the future, inspiration to move forward. In order to reach the cosmos, the immortal one must go as high as possible.
Hint: Something hidden, the veil obscures, a language unspoken... In the darkness, she was born again.
Hint: Positivity, optimism, an inquisitive soul; they know more than anyone but need a guiding hand. Help her put the pieces back where they belong.
Hint: Clarity and composure, the young dragon faces many challenges that weigh on them. But this mind is spilt in two. Help him regain balance.
Hint: The eye opens to a new world with each blink, a mystery long hidden among the clouds. But a darkness is slowly blotting out the light... Push it back by fighting the beast.

After opening the second gate, you'll find a cart track inside the left-hand corner. Follow it up and around and the chest will be in front of you guarded by a Veteran enemy.

After Chest A, you can drop down to the right and follow the corridor to the north east. The chest is at the end.

Alternatively, after the first door, you can burn through an ice wall to the north east which leads into the same corridor.

After the first door, go north (past Bangar's route) and around to the left. Halfway along this back path, you can climb a ramp on your left. At the top cross the cart track bridge to the other side and follow around to the right. The chest is guarded by a Champion Stone Summit Crusher.
Take the back path as in Chest C, but continue along it to an ice wall. Burn through this, kill the Veteran Ice Troll, and go to the edge. The chest is now visible to your left.
You can just glide down southbound from the chest D point. After the big door, stick to the left wall and go down the ice ramp. Chest E is under the ramp.
Continue from chest E over the southern bridge (past the Champion Ice Beast) and the chest is found against the far wall.

At the middle bridge, take a right up the path to the northern bridge. On your right before that bridge is an ice wall. This pathway leads onto Almorra's ledge, and the chest is just prior to it on the left.
Go to the northern bridge and cross it. To the south west you should see a Veteran Icebrood Claymore on a circular platform. The chest is on the platform guarded by it.
This chest is underneath the second elevator (the one you use). Either pull the lever without standing on the elevator or glide down after you pull it (Prototype Position Rewinder also works).
After the elevator, follow the path to the first required ice wall. Instead, burn the ice wall to the north and defeat the Champion Ice Elemental. The chest is around the corner to your right.

At the second required ice wall after the elevator turn to your right. There is another ice wall on the right (easier to miss since it's on the inside of the corner). Through here is the chest, by the right hand wall.

When you get to the end of the path (before leaping down to face Almorra), do a 180 degree turn. As you double back, you will see the chest in an alcove on the left (hidden from view when heading to the end).
